payload.text: ST0002/WP05 follow-up, predict's tier grouping, on vc's sequencing after hv's compact (2026-11-13): no run of its own. When cc sends its rebased follow-up's tip (02a5967's plan fields on 70adaf7), write the grouping on it, unbuilt, and give cc the commit and a mutants script before cc starts WP04's slot; it rides that run, and vc reads it from ic's hand-over with cc's run as its run. The grouping: predict sums the accounts of the most common subscriptionType and rateLimitTier pair among those the rule can use, compared whole; a tie goes to the active account's tier, else to the lexically first pair (cc's meaning); every other account is left out as another plan's allowance, and the text drops its one-plan assumption.
